newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura asset management firm plans news conference.
newsitem.headline: Nomura asset management firm plans news conference.

text.p: Nomura Investment Management Co, an asset management firm in the Nomura Securities Co Ltd group, said it wants to hold a news conference as early as on Wednesday morning on media reports that it and another asset management company in the group will merge.
The reports said the two firms will merge on October 1, 1997 to create a firm which will manage assets worth a total of more than 15 trillion yen.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the other firm was Nomura Securities Investment Trust Management Co Ltd.

The paper said the merger was planned to cope with an expected increase in competition in the asset management industry as a result of on-going restructuring of Japan's financial and securities industries.
Nomura Investment Management manages small-lot funds from individual investors and Nomura Securities Investment Trust Management manages corporate pension funds and other large funds, the paper said.
